head.meta_description: Provided nursery meals versus packed lunch in Dubai: nut-free control, parent trust, and when to outsource the kitchen.
head.h1: Nursery Meals vs Packed Lunch Dubai

opening_paragraph: Nursery meals vs packed lunch Dubai is not a lifestyle debate. It is a control question. If parents pack, you inherit every lunchbox that comes through the door — nuts, sharing, a yoghurt that has sat in a hot car. If the nursery provides meals, you inherit a kitchen: permits, labelling, a caterer parents will still blame you for if lunch fails. This guide is for managers choosing which risk they want to own, and for parents who need to know what they are paying the fee for.

add_block.new_heading: Do all nurseries in Dubai provide meals?
new_paragraphs: No. Some include lunch in the fee. Others ask parents to pack. More centres are moving to provided meals because enrolment is up, parents are time-poor, and a nut-free rule is easier to hold when one kitchen cooks. Dubai has hundreds of licensed early-childhood centres and tens of thousands of children in them. For most of those children, weekday lunch is most of what they eat.

add_block.new_heading: What packed lunch actually costs you
new_paragraphs: Packed lunch looks cheaper on the P&L. It is not free. Staff still supervise. Someone still polices the nut-free sign. A parent still calls when a child will not eat. You have no matrix, no temperature log, and no answer when another child shares a sandwich.
Provided meals cost a kitchen. They also give you a document you can show: the cycle, the allergen card, the permit. That is the trade.

add_block.new_heading: When provided meals are the right call
new_paragraphs: If your nut-free policy is strict, if parents are already asking who cooks, or if you are tired of the packed-lunch lottery, a documented caterer is the job. Nursery meal plans Dubai only work when the kitchen can be inspected and the matrix is live, not when a cousin cooks at home.
A mixed model — provided lunch, packed on Fridays — is common during a transition. The allergen rule still has to hold for everything that enters the room.

add_block.new_heading: What to put in a catering brief
new_paragraphs: Enrolment, age bands, days, whether lunch is inside the fee, the diet list, and how food arrives at the building. Preschool catering Dubai with a loading bay is a different pack to a villa nursery with a door on a side street.

Do not ask for a from-price before the walk. Market meal plans you will see advertised elsewhere often sit in a band parents already know. That is context. The quote that matters is itemised: food, staff, van, VAT. Nursery catering Dubai is the page for that brief.
